description: FEMA P-2335: Visual Damage States Databases of Reinforced Concrete Components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Santiago Rodriguez Sanchez, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). Welcome to the Visual Damage States Databases of Reinforced Concrete Components! The key purpose of the databases is to facilitate the inspection process and damage classification of earthquake-damaged components using experimental data from laboratory tests that document damage as a function of prescribed damage states and damage classes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 15 top-level files (PDF, XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-26gf-dn35. Keywords: Reinforced concrete, Post-earthquake assessment, Visible damage, Experimental testing, Damage classification, Visual damage states. Published 2024-09-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
